title: Choose the case study structure
question: The world is settled (Lanyard & Badge). Pick how the /projects/[slug] page is put together, or re-roll.

options.label: Badge-back dossier
options.thesis: The first viewport is the 30-second version printed on a badge back; the full story follows, clipped to the cord.
materials: badge stock card on a webbing stub
options.viewport: Left: a hanging stock card with name, outcome, role/year, stack, four key metrics and links. Right: the hero screenshot or demo video as a print.
options.risk: Two summaries (card and story) can repeat each other if the story does not go deeper.

options.label: Event program
options.thesis: Read like a printed event program: a sticky agenda-style index on the left, one stock page per section on the right.
options.viewport: Huge project name and outcome over the ground, hero print top right; below, the index (Problem, Role, Approach, Architecture, Results, Gallery) beside the first stock page.
options.risk: Metrics sit inside Results, so a skimming recruiter must scroll or jump to see proof.

options.label: Results first
options.thesis: Proof before story: before/after metric tags hang from a webbing rail right under the title.
materials: die-cut metric tags with before values
options.viewport: Project name and outcome, a horizontal webbing rail with four hanging metric tags (struck-through before value, big after value), then the hero print and a short context column.
options.risk: Projects without strong numbers look thin; the rail needs at least two honest metrics.
